ND.openHint: Access CITYNET maps and available location dossiers.
ND.invalidCategoryPrefix: Use a unique marker prefix per category: 1-4 letters or digits, starting with a letter.
ND.invalidMarkerNumber: Invalid marker numbering data. Numbers must be between 01 and 99.
ND.categoryFull: This category already contains 99 places. Reassign or delete a place before adding another.
ND.numberingActiveGM: The active GM must create places or change their category so marker numbers remain unique.
ND.categoriesHelp: Define names, colors and unique marker prefixes (e.g. PU for Public Services). Marker numbers 01-99 stay fixed, even when hidden. Gaps are reused only after reaching 99. Changes apply only when saved. Reassign all dossiers before deleting a category. At least one category must remain.
ND.categoryInUse: This category is still used by dossiers. Reassign them before deleting it.
ND.lastCategory: At least one category must remain.
ND.invalidCategory: This category is no longer available. Choose an existing category before saving.
ND.categoryConflict: Categories changed elsewhere. Close and reopen the category editor.
ND.invalidCategories: Invalid category configuration. Restore valid category names, IDs and hex colors in the world setting.
ND.exampleCategoriesReassigned: Some example categories no longer exist. Those examples were assigned to the first configured category.
ND.emptyPlacesGM: No places yet. Use GM TOOLS → Add place to create a place and share it with players.
ND.emptyPlacesPlayer: No places have been shared with you yet. The GM can add and share places.
ND.emptyDistrictsGM: No districts yet. Use GM TOOLS → Map and districts to draw a boundary.
ND.emptyDistrictsPlayer: The GM has not added any districts yet.
ND.emptyRoute: Set a start on the map or choose a shared place. Ground routes need a street network.
ND.choosePlace: Select a location for its dossier or a district for local intel.
ND.mapAlt: City map with interactive dossier markers
ND.mapHint: Select a local image using Foundry's file browser. Switching maps preserves dossiers and map configurations without automatically transferring them to the new map.
ND.invalidImageDimensions: The map image width and height must each be between 100 and 20000 pixels.
ND.mapChanged: The map image changed while loading. Please try again.
ND.mapSetupActiveGM: The active GM must open the map first to set up its image dimensions.
ND.mapRemoved: The previously bundled map is no longer included. Your data remains stored; select your own local map image in module settings.
ND.customMapCredit: Custom map image: Check its rights and attribution yourself.
ND.examplesReady: Example dossiers are ready. Share each dossier when appropriate.
ND.confirmExamples: Add seven optional example dossiers (such as Afterlife) with markers? They start private and are not shared automatically. Existing examples are not duplicated. Missing example categories are replaced by the first configured category.
ND.communityOnlyMigrated: Only Community Night City 2045 is now available. Old map configurations and their automatically created examples were removed. Your own dossiers remain stored and are not relocated to another map.
ND.error: Neon Dossiers could not complete the action:
ND.gmOnly: Only a GM can change dossiers.
ND.invalidPlace: An invalid dossier was skipped. See the console for details.
ND.imageError: A local dossier or map image could not be loaded. Check its path and file access.
ND.shared: Default access: all players can observe.
ND.private: Default access: private. Individual grants may exist; check Permissions.
ND.confirmDelete: Permanently delete this place and its private GM notes?
ND.title: Title
ND.positionHelp: Drag the map to pan; click to place the marker. Drag the marker itself or use arrow keys; Shift moves it further. Moving removes any existing road access, which may need to be traced again. Changes take effect only when saved.
ND.mapHelp: Drag the map to pan. Districts and places are on the left; a district filters places by map position. Dossiers slide out alongside. Route controls, zoom and sources are on the right.
ND.mapControls: City map: drag or use scrollbars and arrow keys to pan
ND.noStarterData: No starter places are provided for this custom map. Add your own dossiers.
ND.campaignDefaults: Threat levels and scale are campaign defaults, not official ratings. Boundaries, POI anchors and the partial street network are approximate.
ND.invalidAtlas: Invalid map configuration. Check the local map path in module settings or restore a valid atlas configuration.
ND.pickStartHelp: Click the map background to set your starting position.
ND.noRoads: CITYNET: No path data available for this travel mode.
ND.noRoute: CITYNET: No through route available. Change travel mode or location.
ND.invalidAccess: CITYNET: Access unavailable for this travel mode.
ND.unconnectedPlace: CITYNET: Start or destination is outside mapped paths. Choose a location on a path.
ND.drawRoadHelp: Click consecutive street points on the map. Click existing nodes to actually connect them. Trace streets and bridges only, not water or buildings. Crossing lines are not connected without a shared node. Choose travel modes; changes apply only on save.
ND.interactiveNetworkHelp: Drag a point or select a segment. Double-click a segment to insert a point. You can still pan and zoom the map.
ND.drawInteractiveHelp: Click the map to add points. Click existing points to connect streets.
ND.checkHelp: Amber: endpoints; red: geometric crossings without connections (possibly overpasses). Components ignore one-way directions.
ND.directionHelp: The map arrow shows the forward direction. Choose an allowed direction for each travel mode.
ND.confirmDeleteNode: Delete this point and all connected street segments? Count:
ND.confirmDeleteSegment: Delete this segment for all travel modes?
ND.networkDraftNotice: Changes take effect only after saving. Delete removes the selection; Ctrl+Z undoes a change.
ND.networkDraftLost: Unsaved street changes were discarded when leaving the scene.
ND.networkConflict: The street network changed elsewhere. Close and reopen the editor.
ND.accessWarningText: Moved or deleted points affect place access paths. Please redraw those paths after saving. Affected places:
ND.invalidRoad: Choose at least two distinct street points and one travel mode.
ND.oneWay: One-way in drawing direction (for the selected travel modes)
ND.networkHelp: Traced partial network, not a complete street or traffic-rule survey. Colors distinguish connected components. Amber circles: endpoints (including legitimate dead ends). Red circles: geometric crossings without a shared node; these may be overpasses and are NOT connected automatically. Click a segment to edit modes, direction or delete it. Connectivity ignores direction; a one-way street may still prevent the return route.
ND.confirmDeleteRoad: Remove this street segment? Routes or place access paths may become unusable.
ND.confirmPresetRoads: This map's streets will be replaced by the module preset. Custom street edits will be lost. Districts, scale and dossiers are preserved. Existing place access paths may become invalid; review them afterwards.
ND.presetRoadsReady: Preset streets loaded. Please review existing place access paths.
ND.accessHelp: Places snap within 20 m of mapped paths. Cars and Bikes can use a walking leg along the graph to a vehicle street. For unmapped access, trace a walkable path from the place and finish at a red node. Amber marks walking access to the vehicle.
ND.finishAccess: Finish the access path by clicking a street node, or cancel tracing first.
ND.sceneUnavailable: The Neon Dossiers map scene is not ready. The GM must create it and activate it for players.
ND.sceneUpdating: The map scene is being updated. If this message remains, the active GM must reopen the map scene; check error notifications.
ND.atlasHelp: Set image size and map width for distances. Select and edit districts on the map.
ND.districtShapeHelp: Drag corners; small midpoint handles insert corners. Select a corner and press Delete or use the button to remove it. While drawing: click adds points, drag pans the map. Click the first point or choose Finish boundary to close. At least three corners; changes apply only when saved.
ND.districtPointLimit: Maximum 100 corners per district. Remove an existing corner before inserting another.
ND.confirmRedrawDistrict: Redraw this boundary? Undo can restore the previous shape; nothing is saved until you apply it.
ND.confirmDeleteDistrict: Remove this district? Associated places keep their data, but their district assignment needs review.
ND.mapMismatch: Select the map image first; the configuration image must match it.
ND.invalidDistrict: The selected district no longer exists.
ND.sceneReady: Map scene updated. Dossiers, routes and GM tools are overlaid directly on the scene. Activate it in Foundry to bring players.
